name: HeyLead
tagline: AI agent for LinkedIn outreach: find the right people, write in your voice, follow up, handle replies
description: HeyLead is an AI agent for LinkedIn outreach: it finds the right people, writes to them in the voice of your own LinkedIn posts, follows up, and handles replies. It runs from Claude Code, Cursor, any MCP client or a web dashboard. A campaign has one of six goals, and the ICP, the fit check and the messages follow it: Sell a product or service, Find a job, Hire people, Find partners or investors, Find a vendor and Research interviews. This skill gives your OpenClaw agent 22 tools. Campaigns stay drafts until you launch them; after launch HeyLead sends from the cloud within rate limits and quiet hours, and opening messages and follow-ups wait for your approval unless you switch to autopilot.

pricing.free_tier: Hosted: up to 2 follow-ups per prospect; invitation limits follow the LinkedIn account. Self-hosted free installs have monthly quotas: 50 invitations, 20 messages, 30 engagements, 1 active campaign, 3 ICP generations.
pricing.pro_price: $29 per connected LinkedIn account per month

requirements.accounts: Google account + LinkedIn account (connected during setup)
